away.summary: The Los Angeles Kings (0-2-1) are seeking their first win of the season as they visit the Vegas Golden Knights. They recalled forward Jared Wright from the AHL Ontario Reign on Oct 9 to bolster their roster. No injuries or scratches were reported for the Kings in the provided articles.

home.summary: The Vegas Golden Knights (4-1-0) host the Los Angeles Knights in their first meeting of the season. They are coming off a 4-3 shootout win over the Toronto Maple Leafs, highlighted by Jack Eichel's first penalty-shot goal of the season. Victor Olofsson remains out with an undisclosed injury, week to week, while Adin Hill is projected to start in goal.
